changes.to: Issue #1 (2026-11-24): Arkshel Robotics (Shenzhen, founded 2026-07) unveiled MX01 test footage on 2026-08-12 — humanoid base form that transforms into quadruped and, with a docking flight module, into an aerial configuration. The maker calls it a prototype and says final appearance and structure may change; no height, weight, payload, speed, battery or DoF figure is published on arkshel.com, so those fields stay empty. Locomotion kept as the base humanoid form; the machine is multi-form.
Flying transformable humanoid prototype that switches between humanoid, quadruped and aerial configurations (a wheeled mode is in development); the maker publishes no numeric specs.
